prompt:
A bright, authentic DSLR photograph used as a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 — one genuinely captured, candid-looking moment in a real office. The photo looks completely real; only one bold overlay word is added.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the identity reference — render this exact man with an identical face, beard, hair and skin tone, and match the real office visible behind him in Image 1: the soft grey-blue wall and the tall green dracaena plant. Do not stylize his face. Image 2 is a web app interface — reproduce this exact view filling the laptop screen: a pale off-white page showing a KNOWLEDGE GRAPH. One BIG, solid, vivid indigo-blue rounded rectangle sits at the dead centre of the screen, large and unmissable, with thin grey link lines radiating outward from it in every direction to small round grey dots near the edges, and two blue-outlined note cards stacked on the left. The big indigo block is by far the most prominent thing on the screen. Keep the layout, colours and shapes faithful; all small interface text stays tiny and softly unreadable at this distance, and no large readable words appear on the screen.

SUBJECT & ACTION: the man from Image 1 sitting in his desk chair at his office desk, framed chest-up on the right half, caught mid-moment — big genuine amazed open-mouthed grin, raised eyebrows, wide bright eyes, looking straight into the lens while his right arm reaches toward the laptop, index finger pointing directly at the screen, fingertip almost touching it. That pointing hand is correctly formed with five fingers; his left hand rests on the desk edge; no other hands anywhere.

COMPOSITION: on the left half of the desk, an open laptop angled three-quarters toward the camera so the viewer sees the screen clearly, showing the app from Image 2 bright and crisp — the big indigo graph node and its radiating links clearly visible as the focal point of the screen. It is a generic slim laptop with a plain dark bezel and no logos or lettering anywhere on the hardware. The screen is NOT blown out or glowing: it is a soft, gently dimmed off-white, clearly darker than his brightly lit face, so his face stays the brightest thing in the picture and the screen sits second. On the desk in soft focus: a keyboard, a coffee mug. The grey-blue wall and the tall green plant from Image 1 fill the softly blurred background.

LIGHTING & CAMERA: HE IS THE BRIGHTEST THING IN THE FRAME. Soft window daylight falls directly onto his face and chest from camera-left so his face is fully, brightly exposed — bright catchlights in both eyes, bright teeth, rich saturated skin, no shadow band across his cheek or jaw. Behind him the room is noticeably DARKER and falls away: the grey-blue wall sits in gentle shadow and is clearly darker than his face, the window is out of frame and nothing in the background is blown out to white. A soft warm rim light separates his hair and shoulder from the wall. Realistic white balance and warm skin tones preserved, a faint cool glow from the laptop screen on his pointing hand; shot like a candid 35mm photo at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, sharp on his face, his pointing finger and the screen; a rich, punchy but believable colour grade — a real photograph, deep and contrasty, not a flat snapshot and not a composite.

TEXT: across the top of the frame there is a STRONG dark gradient scrim. It is solid black along the very top edge and STAYS almost solid black all the way down past the bottom of the lettering — the whole band of the frame that the headline occupies is near-black — and only below the letters does it begin to fade, reaching fully transparent by the middle of the frame. Everything behind the headline — wall, window, plant — is crushed into near-blackness by this scrim, so every letter sits on a genuinely black ground, never on a mid-tone or a leafy green shape. Over that scrim, exactly ONE overlay element — "100% FREE" (characters 1-0-0-%, then F-R-E-E) in huge vivid-green condensed capitals with a subtle grunge texture, a hard black outline and a hard drop shadow, across the top-left of the frame above the laptop, razor sharp and perfectly spelled. Absolutely no other text, numbers, badges, strips or logos anywhere else in the image.

STYLE: an authentic, warm, believable office photo elevated into a high-CTR thumbnail — bright subject against a darker room, punchy and premium, uncluttered; the single headline crisp, perfectly spelled and razor sharp.
